theme: An open calendar and a quiet inbox.
greeting: Nothing's on the calendar today, Dan, and the inbox is all newsletters — a genuinely clear stretch. The one fixed point ahead is tomorrow's NACD committee at midday.

needsAttention.title: NACD New England programming committee
needsAttention.detail: You sit on the committee and the meeting's tomorrow at 1 PM ET on Zoom. Worth arriving with a program idea or two — a good slice of your board network in one room.

needsAttention.title: Maine Christmas SUV still open
needsAttention.detail: The p1 you flagged as most likely to bite: a full-size SUV out of Portland over Christmas week sells out early. A refundable hold now costs nothing and closes the risk; dates can shift later.

needsAttention.title: St Pete Airbnb was pending
needsAttention.detail: The Sept 27-Oct 5 booking charges Sept 18 and was still awaiting the host's acceptance - a quick check that it converted to confirmed, rather than quietly expiring, is worth the minute.

flagged.title: myFICO balance-decreased alert
flagged.detail: Routine monitoring notice - a Synchrony account balance ticked down. Benign, nothing to action.

inbox.noise: The rest is newsletters, retail, and travel-loyalty updates - AT&T, American, Adobe, Substack digests, a Maine news roundup.
inbox.clear: Nothing in the inbox is waiting on your reply.

recipe.title: Borlotti beans with sautéed baby kale
recipe.why: Early autumn brings the last of the fresh shell beans and the first tender kale — a warm, earthy plate for the turning season.

tasks.title: Book Sept 20-Oct 5 rental car (Full-Size SUV, TPA)

acts.line: Nothing on the calendar - the day opens with no claim on it.
An unbroken open stretch, yours to spend.
A quiet close; the week's only meeting waits until tomorrow midday.
